theorem.statement: For every NAE model y, h -> y XOR h is a bijection from globally valid repair masks to models of the original instance and an isomorphism of their single-flip solution graphs.

sources: Gopalan, Kolaitis, Maneva, Papadimitriou, The Connectivity of Boolean Satisfiability: Computational and Structural Dichotomies
Cardinal, Demaine, Eppstein, Hearn, Winslow, Reconfiguration of Satisfying Assignments and Subset Sums: Easy to Find, Hard to Connect, 2018
source_barrier.consequence: Do not use generic satisfying single-flip repair-path search as a polynomial rank mechanism.

active_gate.target: Poly-synthesized structural transformer mu plus universal descent rank rho, computed directly from the instance rather than by solving the repair-mask CSP.
